items.title: Mercado Bitcoin begins post-hack reopening without a timeline for withdrawals
items.sum: Customers can view their pre-hack balances as access returns in phases. The exchange has yet to say when withdrawals will resume.

items.title: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits
items.sum: The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit.

items.title: Avalanche's AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal
items.sum: Avalanche's AVAX token rose as much as 10% after the NYSE selected its blockchain to support settlement on a planned tokenized stock trading platform.

items.title: Bitcoin, tech stocks brush off Nvidia nerves as analyst mulls $68K target
items.sum: Bitcoin rebounded from an 11-week low near $73,500 as the Nasdaq Composite rallied despite sell-off in Nvidia shares.

items.title: Analysts see no broader 'contagion' from $6.3B Binance hack
items.sum: Binance's pledge to cover all user losses helped contain the fallout from the $6.3 billion hack, analysts said.

items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.sum: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Binance Hack Launderers Mint Elon Musk and Animal Meme Coins to Move Stolen Crypto
items.sum: Elliptic says the hackers are minting their own worthless tokens-complete with cartoon animal and Elon Musk logos-and routing stolen funds through liquidity pools to break the trail.

items.title: Bitcoin in Limbo as Stocks Rebound Ahead of US Inflation Report
items.sum: U.S. stocks rallied as oil fell, but Bitcoin hovered near $75,000 after a wave of liquidations, with Tuesday's inflation report set to test bets on a December Fed rate hike.

items.title: Nvidia's $350 Billion Scare: What Happens If Jensen Huang Leaves?
items.sum: Nvidia shares slid as much as 8% amid spy allegations. The stock was already weakening, and investors now face a bigger question: Who replaces Jensen Huang if he suddenly leaves?

items.title: Solana Set for Another Tokenized Stock Venue as Formation Notifies the SEC
items.sum: Formation Securities notified the SEC of plans for a Solana-based tokenized stock venue.

items.title: Vitalik Buterin Moves On From Ultrasound Money, Says ETH Value Is Stability
items.sum: The Ethereum co-founder says ETH value comes from stability, not fee burns.

items.title: Tom Lees Bitmine Adds 20M in Ethereum
items.sum: The firms stash reached 6.07 million ETH, 4.97 percent of supply.
